description: This file defines the AppConfig class responsible for loading and accessing environment variables from a .env file in a Flutter project. It provides a singleton pattern to ensure environment variables are loaded only once and exposes a getter for the API base URL with validation.

classes.name: AppConfig
classes.description: A class to manage application configuration variables loaded from a .env file, including a method to load the variables and a getter for the API base URL with validation.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads environment variables from the `.env` file; ensures loading occurs only once.

methods.name: apiBaseUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the API base URL from environment variables with validation to ensure it exists and is not empty.
